deadlines.empty: No deadlines yet. Add one with "New deadline".

form.title: Title

alerts.summary_one: You have {{count}} alert to look at.
alerts.summary_other: You have {{count}} alerts to look at.

setup.title: Set up the vault
setup.intro: Passwords are encrypted (AES-256) before being saved to OneDrive. You open them with Windows Hello; on a new PC or in an emergency you will need a recovery key.
setup.recoveryText: Keep it somewhere safe, away from this PC (printed or in another password manager). This is the only time it is shown: without it and without Windows Hello the passwords cannot be recovered.
setup.copied: Copied: it will be cleared from the clipboard in 30 seconds.
setup.confirmLabel: To confirm, type the last group of the key
setup.confirmCheck: I have stored it somewhere safe
setup.helloText: Open the vault with your face, fingerprint or PIN. It applies to this PC only.
setup.helloUnavailable: Windows Hello is not available on this PC: you will use the recovery key.

link.title: Link this PC
link.text: A vault created on another PC already exists in OneDrive. Enter the recovery key to link this PC; then you can turn on Windows Hello here too. Until then, deadlines and reminders from other PCs cannot be read.

errors.hello-notFound: The Windows Hello registration is no longer valid: use the recovery key and turn it on again.
errors.hello-locked: Windows Hello is locked. Try again later.
errors.hello-mismatch: Windows Hello does not match: use the recovery key and turn it on again.
errors.already-configured: The vault is already set up.

vault.helloBanner: Turn on Windows Hello on this PC to open the vault without the recovery key.
vault.newPasswordDone: New password generated and copied. Remember to update it on the site too.

form.name: Name
form.manualChangeHint: If you change the password the countdown restarts from today.

generator.title: Generator
generator.newHint: The current password goes into the history and the countdown restarts from today.

alert.soon_one: The password for "{{name}}" needs changing tomorrow. Shall I generate a new one?
alert.soon_other: The password for "{{name}}" needs changing in {{count}} days. Shall I generate a new one?

groups.label: Folder
groups.dropRoot: Drop here to move to the top level
groups.dragHint: Drag passwords and folders to reorganize them. Deleting a folder moves its contents up one level.

ai.systemPrompt: You are Pix, the fluid mascot and assistant of a personal Windows app that shares your name. If asked who you are, say you are Pix. Answer in the user's language. Be clear and concise and use Markdown when it helps (lists, tables, code blocks). You have no access to files, commands, the Internet or other tools: if they are needed, explain to the user how to proceed.

chat.placeholder: Type a message or / for commands… (Enter sends, Shift+Enter for a new line)
chat.empty: Ask Pix a question, or type / for quick commands.

quickPrompts.translate: Translate the following text into Italian (if it is already Italian, translate it into English):
quickPrompts.email: Write a polite, concise email to:
quickPrompts.fix: Fix spelling, grammar and punctuation in the following text without changing its meaning:

errors.overloaded: Claude is overloaded right now. Try again shortly.

connect.notLoggedInText: Pix uses Claude Code with your claude.ai account (Pro or Max), no API key. Open Claude Code, type /login and follow the steps in the browser; then come back and press "Check again".
connect.unavailableText: Install Claude Code (it takes a few minutes), log in with your account and come back.

clipboard.empty: Nothing yet. Copy something and it will show up here.
clipboard.unavailable: Clipboard history needs Pix's native helper, which is not available.
clipboard.privacy: Stays on this PC only, encrypted. Passwords and sensitive content are never recorded.

maint.title: Backup and sync
maint.needsVault: Backups are encrypted with the recovery key: set up the vault first.
maint.importHint: A backup opens with its recovery key. Data is merged with your current data; nothing is overwritten.
maint.imported_one: Imported: {{count}} file merged into your data.
maint.imported_other: Imported: {{count}} files merged into your data.
maint.conflictsHint: These versions were changed on another PC at the same time and were discarded. Restore them if they were the right ones.
maint.changeDataDirHint: If the new folder is empty I copy the current data there; then Pix restarts.

errors.invalid-backup: The file is not a valid Pix backup.
errors.unlock-first: The backup comes from another vault: unlock the vault first so passwords can be merged too.

shift.remind_other: {{count}} minutes left until the end of your workday ({{time}}).

search.title: Search
search.placeholder: Search notes, to-dos, reminders, deadlines, links, clipboard and passwords…
search.hint: Type to search. In the vault only entry names are searched, never passwords. Enter opens the result, Esc closes.

commands.failed: I couldn't save it. Please try again.
commands.escapeHint: Pix runs them on your PC, not the AI. To send the AI a message starting with /, type //.

errors.unknown: Unknown command: /{{command}}. Type /help for the list.
errors.missingText: Text is missing: for example /{{command}} call Mark.
errors.missingTime: Say when: for example /{{command}} tomorrow 15:30 call Mark, or in 20 min.
errors.missingDate: Add the date: for example /{{command}} 25/12 gifts.
